tldrText: API calls are like little door swings at a very busy store: one customer entering is harmless, but autocomplete, filters, page loads, bots, and eager widgets can turn that door into a blur.Short version: yes, almost every interaction that requests data from an Algolia index counts as a billable search request.
detailsText: DetailsDebounce ordinary typing, avoid duplicate page-load searches, and protect shared backend traffic with server-side throttling.Supporting evidence: Rate limiting API keys | Understand search request usage
followupText: Are you protecting against bot traffic, or trying to keep normal browsing costs predictable?
